name: Keiji J.B. Harold no Jikenbo: Kiss of Murder
summary:
December 30th, West 10th Street, Greenwich Village. A young woman was murdered.

The victim's name was Sarah Shields.

She had been entrusted with a huge sapphire that was insured for a large amount of money by someone.

With her death, the sapphire disappeared...

Judd, a former detective who is now an insurance investigator in Manhattan, contacts J.B. of his former workplace to investigate the murder and the sapphire's whereabouts...

A completely different story that takes place in the same world as "Manhattan Requiem."

J.B. races through the streets of New York in search of the truth.
